page.overview:
Who is Hudson?

is the main protagonist of What We Found, the third story of Fazbear Frights #8: Gumdrop Angel. He's a severely traumatized young man who struggles to move on after his abusive step-father and neglectful mother are both killed in a fire. Hudson's friends eventually convince him to become a security guard at Fazbear's Fright Horror Attraction, where he works despite his illogical fear of the old things around the attraction.

Hudson is a skinny six feet, one inch tall man with short blond hair, a few days old pale beard, blue eyes, and a wide mouth full of straight white teeth.

Hudson is a victim of child abuse, reacting mainly out of traumatic responses. Years of living in fear have caused him to be paranoid and easily frightened. Hudson also gets irritated and defensive when confronted about his past, leading to poor treatment from others. While he finds a bit of enjoyment of getting back at those who are mean to him, he never acts on these desires. Hudson is constantly spacing out when he thinks of his past, although he has many suppressed memories and is only able to face his past in snippets. He actively tries to grow past his early life but he still feels alone in the world and doesn't take rejection well, causing him to revert back. Still, Hudson does find comfort when around his friends, Barry and Duane. He tries acting playful and relaxed around them, with varying degrees of success.

Hudson grew up happy and cheerful. He and his best friends Barry and Duane loved going to an old-fashioned soda fountain ice-cream parlor called Charlie's, a tradition they kept into their adulthood. His Granny Foster would always give him wise and spiritual life advice, such as heat and fire purging. However, Hudson's life took a turn for the worse after his father, Steven, took his life after a bad deal cost him his small business.
